name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro
attention_variant: MLA variant with compressed KV, sliding_window 128, sparse indexer index_topk 1024; kv_lora_rank absent from config
notes: The 1.6T flagship of the V4 preview. Vendor: 1.6T total / 49B activated, 1M context, trained on 32T+ tokens; safetensors total 1598.84B. Config: 61 layers (same depth as V3), hidden 7168, 384 routed + 1 shared experts (up from V3's 256), 6 per token, moe_intermediate_size 3072, head_dim 512, num_key_value_heads 1, q_lora_rank 1536, YaRN factor 16 over 65536, sliding_window 128, index_topk 1024. kv_cache_bytes_per_token is null for the same reason as V4-Flash: no kv_lora_rank in the config, and the compressed-cache geometry is not derivable from the fields present. Released as FP4 + FP8 mixed (expert params in FP4), so the published weights are far below 1.6 TB. MIT.
